g.text: Frozen example: holdout-00, phase index 337, norm 0.016, dt 0.005
First eligible anchor and first phase in frozen order; largest dose; all saved 0–300 samples. Gray interval: simulator preview 0–75.
Tail-fit phase uses only 75<t≤300 and stays constant over the whole error trace; each policy has its own reference shift. No frequency fitting or time warp.
The synchronous reference on the left is not the phase-aligned reference used for the error statistic.
